creator: Alexander Terp
description:
A pane whose bridge keeps ending probably raises its "cannot be typed into" error again after every ending, which would reopen a roster somebody closed once per ending. Read from the code, not seen in the app.

`Waiting::ended` restarts the wait each time a bridge ends, so the error clears (`problem.cleared why=restarted`, logged since `c1fefa0`) and is raised again one deadline later. `corpus/conformance/typeable.json` pins this: "a reported pane whose bridge ends is taken back and said again". Each re-raise is a real change to `raise_problem`, and an Error-severity problem is what opens the roster.

This is not new behavior. The new `problem.raised` / `problem.cleared` records make it visible, which is how slot 1 of the 2026-09-12 round found it while fixing `a_2LMpvavhA`.

## Validating

- A pane whose bridge ends every few seconds: count `problem.raised` records for its key in the run log, and check whether the roster reopens after each one.
- If it does, decide whether a re-raise of the same key and detail inside some window should be a change at all.
title: A pane whose bridge keeps ending may reopen the roster once per ending
